evidence.text: Construct scalar potentials using very special geometry, holomorphic symplectic sections, Kähler metrics, Killing vectors and moment maps. sources.title: De Sitter in Extended Supergravity

evidence.text: Structure constants in two SO(3,3) factors are organized into four symmetric SL(4) charge matrices. Jacobi identities constrain their allowed combinations; in the restricted (semi-)simple cases the paired matrices are proportional. Dilatonic potentials are expressed through a superpotential. This also exposes a one-parameter family of SO(3,1) embeddings, including a null embedding.

evidence.text: The authors construct gauge generators from the embedding tensor, form the scalar potential using the coset matrix M = LLᵀ, and calculate full scalar mass spectra analytically at the identified critical points.

sources.title: De Sitter solutions in N=4 matter coupled supergravity

evidence.text: Solve the matter constraint using the first six rows of an SO(6,6+m) matrix after changing to the diagonal metric basis. The construction uses symmetric G, antisymmetric B, and a 6×m matrix U; explicit examples set m=0.

sources.title: Potential and mass matrix in gauged N=4 supergravity

evidence.text: Solve the matter-scalar constraint using symmetric G and antisymmetric B, and differentiate with respect to the 36 independent entries of P=G+B. At G=I, B=0 the matter kinetic term is −(1/2)∂Pab∂Pab, so the matter Hessian is the canonically normalized scalar mass-squared matrix there.

sources.title: Stable de Sitter Vacua in 4 Dimensional Supergravity Originating from 5 Dimensions

evidence.text: Use a large-curvature-radius contraction of SO(2,1) to SO(1,1) ⋉ R(1,1). Separately contract the centrally extended algebra obtained from dimensional reduction, taking a singular β → 0 limit that removes the central charge.

evidence.text: Analyze the holomorphic–antiholomorphic Hessian block Vab̄ at an extremum, then tune third derivatives of W to make the holomorphic block Vab vanish or sufficiently small. Positive Vab̄ then gives full local stability only under the latter condition.

sources.title: The Wasteland of Random Supergravities

evidence.text: Decompose the Hessian into supersymmetric, holomorphic, Kähler-derivative and shift terms. Approximate its bulk spectrum by a Wigner matrix plus two Wishart matrices and a translation; compute the free convolution using polynomial equations for Stieltjes transforms.

sources.title: Analytic Classes of Metastable de Sitter Vacua

evidence.text: Expand W locally through third order and solve V = Λ, prescribed F terms, stationarity, and selected Vab conditions. For superpotentials linear in adjustable coefficients, these local derivative conditions can determine explicit global coefficient families.
